title: hieracium kotschyanum subsp. nigrilacus
intro: Hieracium kotschyanum subsp. nigrilacus, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species found in the mountainous regions of Greece. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium kotschyanum subsp. nigrilacus involve the stimulation of the immune system and the reduction of inflammation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
